name: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive (30 datasets)
description: A collection of 30 real-world time-series forecasting datasets assembled for evaluating forecasting methods, spanning domains and frequencies. Includes the Electricity Transformer Temperature (ETT) benchmark's four subsets: ETTh1, ETTh2, ETTm1, and ETTm2.
citation: Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G. I., Hyndman, R. J., & Montero-Manso, P. (2021). Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive. Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '21), 467–474. https://doi.org/10.1145/3459637.3482137

license.identifier: Dataset-specific terms; not a standard SPDX identifier
license.notes: The archive aggregates datasets from different sources and does not establish one standard SPDX license identifier covering all material.
